title: Constructible sheaves are quotients of finite sums of j_{V!}Λ_V
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite ring. Every constructible sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] admits an epimorphism $\bigoplus_{i=1}^nj_{i!}\Lambda_{V_i}\twoheadrightarrow F$ from a finite direct sum of extensions by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] of constant sheaves $\Lambda_{V_i}$, where each $j_i\colon V_i\to X$ is étale with $V_i$ affine and admits a compactification (Stacks 095M; SGA 4½ Rapport 4.6).

theorem exists_epi_sigma_lowerShriek_constantSheaf [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) [IsConstructibleSheaf F] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (j : ∀ i, V i ⟶ X),
      (∀ i, Etale (j i) ∧ IsAffine (V i)) ∧
      ∃ (_ : ∀ i, HasCompactification (j i))
        (φ : (∐ fun i ↦ (Etale.lowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (j i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (V i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of Λ Λ))) ⟶ F), Epi φ :=
  sorry
